metadata.title: Global Macro Economy Pressure & Expansion Radar
metadata.regime_headline: US AI Capex & Tariff 2.0 vs China Debt Deflation (PPI -2.9%) & Factory Overcapacity
metadata.global_conclusion: The world economy is bifurcated between US technological compute expansion and Chinese industrial dumping. While US 10Y yields (~4.42%) and King Dollar (DXY 106.25) create emerging market currency friction (USD/INR ₹84.42), China's domestic deflation and cheap commodity supply chains provide major input-cost tailwinds to India.

executive_hud.health_verdict: Global health index at 52.4/100. Resilient US Tech Capex (54.9 PMI) and Indian domestic manufacturing (58.6 PMI) offset European de-industrialization (46.0 PMI) and Chinese property deflation (-10.3% YoY).

supply_demand_control_levers.headline: HOW SUPERPOWERS CONTROL GLOBAL SUPPLY & DEMAND
supply_demand_control_levers.description: Global superpowers actively manipulate energy valves, monetary liquidity taps, industrial subsidies, and maritime chokepoints to enforce dominance.

levers.name: 1. The Hydrocarbon Energy Valve (OPEC+ & US Shale)
levers.controller: Saudi Arabia (OPEC+ Quotas) & US (Permian Shale 13.5M bpd)
levers.how_they_control: OPEC+ restricts supply by 2.2M bpd to defend a $70 floor, while US shale drillers maintain record production (13.5M bpd). Current Brent: $73.4/bbl.
levers.shock_scenario: Middle East / Iran escalation or Strait of Hormuz tanker blockage shuts off 20% of maritime crude transit, causing an immediate +$15-20/bbl risk premium spike.
levers.india_transmission: India imports >85% of crude. Every $10/bbl oil increase expands India's annual trade deficit by ~$13B, depreciates INR by 25-35 paise, and crushes margins for Paints, Tyres, and OMCs.

levers.name: 2. The Dollar Liquidity & Yield Tap (US Fed & Treasury)
levers.controller: US Federal Reserve & US Treasury Auction Desk
levers.how_they_control: By maintaining higher policy rates and massive Treasury debt issuance, US 10Y yields (~4.42%) stay elevated, sucking capital out of emerging markets into US dollar assets (DXY 106.25).
levers.shock_scenario: Sticky US services inflation delays Fed cuts, keeping King Dollar elevated and creating a persistent foreign exchange squeeze on emerging currencies.
levers.india_transmission: FII equity outflows; RBI actively utilizes its $675.0B forex buffer to prevent disorderly Rupee depreciation past 84.50.

levers.name: 3. The Factory Overcapacity Tap (China State Mandates)
levers.how_they_control: Facing domestic property collapse (-10.3%), China directs state subsidies into manufacturing 2x-3x domestic demand, dumping surplus overseas (China PPI -2.9%).
levers.shock_scenario: 25-month producer price deflation prompts predatory export dumping across Asian and Latin American markets to keep Chinese domestic factories operating.
levers.india_transmission: Crushes profit margins for domestic primary commodity producers (Tata Steel, JSW, UPL), but provides massive input cost deflation to downstream solar developers, real estate, and consumer tech assemblers.

levers.name: 4. Geopolitical Chokepoints & Freight Valve (Red Sea & Straits)
levers.how_they_control: Attacks on Bab-el-Mandeb / Red Sea compel cargo container ships to reroute around Africa's Cape of Good Hope, tripling container spot freight rates and adding 14 days transit time. Baltic Dry: 1680.0 pts.
levers.shock_scenario: Coordinated chokepoint blockades in Red Sea or Malacca Strait freeze container slot availability, causing global supply chain delays.
levers.india_transmission: Exporters of textiles, auto parts, and basmati rice face inflated freight invoices and delayed receivables, while European export demand contracts.

sector_margin_demand_matrix.headline: SECTOR MARGIN PRESSURE vs EXPANSION RADAR
sector_margin_demand_matrix.description: Quantifies which domestic and global sectors gain operating leverage versus which face margin compression under current global macro flows (Crude $73.4, DXY 106.25, China PPI -2.9%).

margin_expansion_sectors.driver: Global AI data center electricity crunch and transmission equipment shortages (US Services 54.9).
Chinese factory-gate deflation (-2.9% PPI) reduces imported solar module construction costs.
Multinationals re-routing supply chains into India (58.6 PMI) to bypass US-China tariff barriers.
Global NATO and Indo-Pacific defense procurement supercycle and indigenous defense offsets.
Brent crude at $73.4/bbl keeps titanium dioxide and solvent raw material costs contained.

margin_pressure_sectors.driver: Chinese hot-rolled coil dumping (China PPI -2.9%) suppresses domestic Indian steel realisations.
Predatory Chinese generic active ingredient price war (-2.9% PPI) and channel destocking.
European manufacturing contraction (46.0 PMI) and German automotive plant closures.
US 10Y Yield at 4.42% forcing enterprise CIOs to divert discretionary spend strictly to generative AI.

import_export_dynamics.details: High crude oil ($73.4/bbl) and electronics components create foreign currency demand; offset by cheap steel imports.
European export demand (46.0 PMI) softens; high-value smartphone and aerospace exports to US surge +23.4% YoY.

dynamic_shock_transmission_engine.headline: LIVE GEOPOLITICAL & SUPPLY SHOCK DETECTOR
dynamic_shock_transmission_engine.status_summary: Surveillance of Middle East crude routes ($73.4/bbl), DXY dollar spikes (106.25), and Chinese dumping.

shocks.shock_name: Middle East Conflict & Hormuz Crude Supply Choke
shocks.trigger: US-Iran military friction and maritime risk along Strait of Hormuz tanker routes. Brent trading at $73.4/bbl.
shocks.supply_demand_choke: Threat of 2.0-2.5M bpd oil supply disruption; tanker war risk insurance premiums elevated.
shocks.import_export_shift: India's annual crude import deficit impact: ~+$12.6B; emergency crude diversification to Russian and African grades.
shocks.currency_impact: USD/INR trading at ₹84.42; RBI defending currency with foreign exchange market interventions.

shocks.shock_name: King Dollar & US 10Y Yield Gravity Spike
shocks.trigger: US 10Y yields at 4.42% and DXY at 106.25 driven by resilient US growth (54.9 PMI).
shocks.supply_demand_choke: Dollar liquidity contraction across emerging market banks; foreign institutional capital re-allocating to US T-Bills.
shocks.import_export_shift: Imported energy and electronics become costlier in Rupee terms; dollar export billing gains realization cushion.
shocks.currency_impact: Rupee tests ₹84.42 band; supported by RBI's $675.0B protective warchest.

shocks.trigger: China property contraction (-10.3%) and factory deflation (-2.9% PPI) forcing overseas inventory clearance.
shocks.supply_demand_choke: Global steel, solar, and chemical markets flooded with Chinese inventory priced below international cash cost.
shocks.import_export_shift: Cheap Chinese steel coils and agrochemical intermediates surge into Asian ports, triggering anti-dumping investigations.
shocks.currency_impact: Disinflationary import price effect helps keep wholesale inflation low without direct foreign exchange shock.

pressure_points.title: Universal Tariffs 2.0 & Global Trade War Threat
pressure_points.description: Proposed universal 10-20% baseline tariffs and 60% duties on China threaten to reignite import inflation, strengthen DXY, and disrupt global multi-national corporate supply chains.

pressure_points.title: $35.8T Sovereign Debt & $1.12T Annual Interest Burden
pressure_points.description: Annual federal interest servicing cost has surpassed the entire US Defense budget ($850B), forcing massive Treasury bond issuance waves and steepening the yield curve.

pressure_points.title: US 10-Year Yield Spike (~4.42%) & Equity PE Gravity
pressure_points.description: Persistent long-term Treasury yields above 4.4% raise corporate discount rates, exerting continuous multiple compression on global high-valuation equities.

pressure_points.title: Commercial Real Estate (CRE) & Regional Banking Risk
pressure_points.description: Over $2.2 Trillion in CRE debt matures through 2026 amid remote-work urban vacancies, keeping regional lenders under credit surveillance.

pressure_points.title: K-Shaped Consumer Bifurcation & Debt Delinquencies
pressure_points.description: Top 20% thrive on stock market and real estate wealth, while lower-income consumer credit card and auto loan 90+ day delinquencies have hit 12-year highs.

pressure_points.title: Power Grid Bottlenecks for AI Data Centers
pressure_points.description: Massive hyperscaler compute clusters are straining legacy electric utilities, leading to power shortages and delays in data center energization.

expansion_engines.title: $250B+ Generative AI Compute Supercycle
expansion_engines.description: Hyperscalers (Microsoft, Meta, Google, Amazon, Oracle) driving unprecedented capex in GPU clusters, optical transceivers, and liquid cooling systems.

expansion_engines.title: Nuclear Power Revival for Big Tech (SMRs & PPA Deals)
expansion_engines.description: Big tech contracting directly with nuclear operators (Three Mile Island revival, Talen Energy, SMR startups) to secure 24/7 carbon-free base-load power.

expansion_engines.title: Federal Reserve Interest Rate Easing Cycle
expansion_engines.description: Fed trimming policy rates provides liquidity relief, lowers commercial paper refinancing frictions, and supports corporate debt rollover.

expansion_engines.title: Domestic Energy Dominance (13.5M bpd Crude Oil)
expansion_engines.description: US record hydrocarbon production and massive LNG export terminals ensure industrial energy independence and insulate US factories from foreign price shocks.

expansion_engines.title: CHIPS Act & IRA Domestic Re-Shoring Wave
expansion_engines.description: Over $400B in announced semiconductor fabs (TSMC Phoenix, Intel Ohio, Samsung Texas) and clean energy battery plants actively under construction.

expansion_engines.title: Positive Real Wage Growth & Services Dominance
expansion_engines.description: With gasoline and goods inflation abating, median wage growth exceeds inflation, anchoring retail consumption and domestic services spending.

pressure_points.title: Real Estate Collapse & Balance Sheet Recession
pressure_points.description: 70% of urban wealth was concentrated in property; ongoing developer insolvencies and 30%+ price drops have triggered a severe Japanese-style consumer balance sheet recession.

pressure_points.title: Persistent Factory-Gate Deflation (-2.9% PPI)
pressure_points.description: Industrial overcapacity has caused 25 straight months of negative producer prices, eviscerating corporate profit margins and driving predatory price wars.

pressure_points.title: ¥60 Trillion Local Government (LGFV) Hidden Debt
pressure_points.description: With land sales crashing, municipal authorities face massive revenue shortfalls, delaying payments to contractors, healthcare providers, and local workers.

pressure_points.title: Western Tariff Walls & 'China Shock 2.0' Pushback
pressure_points.description: US (up to 100% on EVs) and EU (up to 45.3%) imposing heavy anti-subsidy duties to prevent Chinese state-backed industrial dumping from wiping out domestic industries.

pressure_points.title: Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) Contraction
pressure_points.description: Supply chain relocation and geopolitical friction have caused net inward foreign investment to turn negative, restricting technology transfer.

pressure_points.title: Demographic Cliff & 17.1% Youth Unemployment
pressure_points.description: Rapidly aging population alongside high youth joblessness is depressing long-term domestic consumption, forcing consumers toward discount platforms.

expansion_engines.title: ¥10 Trillion Local Government Debt Swap Bazooka
expansion_engines.description: National People's Congress approved a ¥10T ($1.4T) debt-swap quota over 3-5 years to replace toxic high-interest off-balance-sheet debt with low-cost sovereign bonds.

expansion_engines.title: Absolute Global Monopoly on Clean-Tech Infrastructure
expansion_engines.description: Controlling >80% of global solar polysilicon, wafers, lithium refining, and LFP EV batteries (CATL & BYD), dominating exports to emerging economies.

expansion_engines.title: National Big Fund III Semiconductor Sovereignty (¥344B)
expansion_engines.description: State-funded $47.5B semiconductor war chest accelerating domestic lithography, SMIC trailing-edge 28nm dominance, and Huawei Ascend AI chip deployment.

expansion_engines.title: Strategic Rare Earth & Critical Mineral Weaponization
expansion_engines.description: Controlling 70% of rare earth mining and 90% of processing; restricting Gallium, Germanium, and Antimony exports as leverage against Western sanctions.

expansion_engines.title: Aggressive Monetary Easing & PBOC Liquidity Injections
expansion_engines.description: Multiple RRR cuts, Loan Prime Rate reductions, and special central bank lending facilities designed to bolster state-owned enterprise balance sheets.

expansion_engines.title: Global South & Belt and Road Trade Expansion
expansion_engines.description: Diversifying exports away from the US towards ASEAN, Middle East, Africa, and Latin America, bypassing traditional Western trade restrictions.

pressure_points.title: German Industrial De-Industrialization
pressure_points.description: Volkswagen planning unprecedented domestic factory closures, and BASF downsizing chemical manufacturing due to uncompetitive energy costs compared to US and China.

pressure_points.title: French & British Fiscal Austerity & Tax Hikes
pressure_points.description: Excessive sovereign deficits forcing tax hikes and spending cutbacks, putting further strain on European consumer discretionary demand.

pressure_points.title: Crushing Energy Transition Cost Disadvantage
pressure_points.description: High electricity tariffs and strict carbon regulations make European heavy industry non-viable against US shale-backed and Chinese subsidized competitors.

expansion_engines.title: Aggressive ECB Interest Rate Cuts
expansion_engines.description: ECB cutting borrowing rates in 25bps increments to rescue credit markets and lower corporate borrowing burdens.

expansion_engines.title: Historic European Defense Spending Supercycle
expansion_engines.description: European defense spending exceeding €350B as NATO members rapidly re-arm stockpiles and artillery systems.

pressure_points.title: Yen Carry Trade Unwinding Fragility
pressure_points.description: Sudden spikes in Japanese bond yields or rapid Yen appreciation trigger multi-billion dollar carry trade liquidations across global equity markets.

pressure_points.title: Imported Inflation Squeezing Household Real Spending
pressure_points.description: Weak Yen has driven food and energy import costs up, weighing on middle-class consumer purchasing power.

expansion_engines.title: Shunto Spring Wage Surge (+5.2%)
expansion_engines.description: Japanese corporations enacted the largest wage hikes in three decades, creating a virtuous wage-price domestic consumption spiral.

expansion_engines.title: Global Semiconductor Fab Buildout (TSMC Kumamoto & Rapidus)
expansion_engines.description: Japan is reclaiming advanced chipmaking with government subsidies drawing global foundries and equipment giants.

pressure_points.title: Strong US Dollar (DXY 106.25) & FII Outflows
pressure_points.description: Elevated US bond yields (4.42%) and dollar strength triggered tactical foreign portfolio rebalancing out of emerging markets into US assets.

pressure_points.title: Chinese Cheap Industrial Dumping (China PPI -2.9%)

expansion_engines.title: China+1 High-Tech Manufacturing Relocation
expansion_engines.description: Global giants (Apple, HP, Dell, Foxconn) investing billions to scale domestic assembly, pushing electronics exports to record highs.

expansion_engines.title: Physical Infrastructure Supercycle
expansion_engines.description: Government capital expenditure across dedicated freight corridors, highways, ports, and power transmission driving domestic capital goods orders.

usa_china_macro_clash.headline: USA vs CHINA: THE TIT-FOR-TAT GEOPOLITICAL & MACRO CLASH
usa_china_macro_clash.overview: The clash between the world's two largest superpowers is reshaping global trade, technology, and capital flows. Understanding this friction explains where economic pain is concentrated and where emerging markets like India gain structural leverage.

battlefields.title: 1. Trade War 2.0 & Tariff Escalation
battlefields.us_offensive: Universal 10-20% baseline tariffs on all global imports, escalating to 60%+ on all Chinese manufacturing, revoking China's PNTR status.
battlefields.china_retaliation: Weaponizing export licenses for critical minerals (Gallium, Germanium, Antimony), targeting US agricultural imports (soybeans/pork), and devaluing RMB to 7.30+ to offset tariff penalties.
battlefields.macro_impact: Squeezes global trade volumes, re-accelerates US imported inflation, and accelerates supply chain flight out of mainland China into ASEAN and India.
battlefields.india_takeaway: Multinationals are compelled to set up secondary manufacturing hubs in India to bypass punitive US tariffs on Chinese origins.

battlefields.title: 2. Semiconductor Blockade & AI Cold War
battlefields.us_offensive: Strict export controls on advanced AI chips (Nvidia H100/H200/Blackwell), ASML extreme UV lithography embargoes, and scrutiny of EDA chip design software.
battlefields.china_retaliation: State-funded ¥344B National Big Fund III, mass-producing legacy 28nm silicon to flood global automotive markets, and developing domestic Huawei Ascend AI accelerators.
battlefields.macro_impact: Bifurcated global tech standards, accelerated duplicate fab investments ($500B+ globally), and soaring GPU compute costs for Western enterprises.
battlefields.india_takeaway: India semiconductor mission (Tata-PSMC Dholera fab, Micron OSAT, Kaynes EMS) gains strategic Western technology transfer backing.

battlefields.title: 3. King Dollar Dominance vs Sovereign Gold Accumulation
battlefields.us_offensive: King Dollar (DXY 106.25) powered by high US yields (~4.42%) drains global liquidity and asserts US Treasury sanctions enforcement.
battlefields.china_retaliation: PBOC continuous gold reserve accumulation (Gold $2655.0/oz), reducing US Treasury holdings below $750B, and expanding CIPS / local currency bilateral settlements.
battlefields.macro_impact: Gold hits all-time records ($2,650+/oz), emerging market central banks diversify reserve currencies, and cross-border payment systems fragment.
battlefields.india_takeaway: RBI expands gold reserves to record 854+ metric tonnes while settling bilateral trade in Rupee-Dirham with Middle East and Asian partners.

battlefields.title: 4. Industrial Overcapacity vs Western Reshoring (China Shock 2.0)
battlefields.us_offensive: Subsidizing domestic clean tech via the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) and CHIPS Act, placing 100% tariffs on Chinese EVs.
battlefields.china_retaliation: Directing state-bank capital into factories to produce 2-3x domestic consumption in solar, batteries, and steel, dumping inventory overseas at below-cash-cost (-2.9% PPI).
battlefields.macro_impact: Severe margin depression for international chemical and steel manufacturers; consumer disinflation in emerging markets purchasing cheap green hardware.
battlefields.impact_on_india: MIXED (HEADWIND FOR COMMODITIES, TAILWIND FOR USERS)
battlefields.india_takeaway: Hurt: Tata Steel, JSW Steel, UPL (margin squeeze from cheap dumping). Benefit: Solar EPC contractors, real estate developers, and consumer electronics assemblers.

battlefields.title: 5. Energy Sovereignty: US Shale vs Chinese Clean-Tech Monopoly
battlefields.us_offensive: US producing world-record 13.5M bpd crude oil and dominating transatlantic LNG exports, shielding US factories from energy shocks.
battlefields.china_retaliation: Controlling 85%+ of global solar wafers, polysilicon refining, and EV battery cell manufacturing, turning green transition into a Chinese hardware monopoly.
battlefields.macro_impact: Traditional hydrocarbon energy security centers in the Americas, while renewable hardware relies entirely on Chinese supply chains.
battlefields.india_takeaway: India benefits from discounted Russian/Middle East crude oil (~$73.4/bbl) while deploying cheap imported solar cells to accelerate renewable capacity.

global_stress_gauges.name: US Dollar Index (DXY)
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: A strong DXY (106.25) drains emerging market liquidity, pressures the Indian Rupee toward 84.42, and triggers foreign institutional investor (FII) reallocations back toward US money markets.

global_stress_gauges.name: US 10-Year Treasury Yield
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: High US long-term risk-free rates (4.42%) compress global equity price-to-earnings (PE) multiples and raise refinancing borrowing hurdles for dollar-denominated emerging market corporate debt.

global_stress_gauges.name: Brent Crude Oil
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: Oil trading at $73.4 is an economic stabilizer for India, keeping the Current Account Deficit (CAD) manageable and protecting operating margins for paints, specialty chemicals, and transport sectors.

global_stress_gauges.name: Sovereign Gold (XAU/USD)
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: Gold trading at $2655.0/oz confirms aggressive reserve diversification by global central banks (PBOC, RBI, Middle East) seeking neutral reserves immune to US dollar sanctions.

global_stress_gauges.name: Global Semiconductor Fab Utilization
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: Near-capacity utilization (94.5%) at leading-edge foundries (TSMC 3nm/5nm) verifies the massive structural demand for AI accelerators, spilling over into domestic Indian electronic manufacturing (EMS) and packaging orders.

global_stress_gauges.name: Baltic Dry Shipping Index
global_stress_gauges.market_impact: Baltic Dry at 1680.0 points confirms steady raw material movements (iron ore, coal, grains) without the transport cost spikes seen during pandemic maritime disruptions.

pressure_headwinds.title: US Corporate IT Discretionary Budget Freezes
pressure_headwinds.reason: US BFSI and retail executives are reprioritizing discretionary software budgets strictly towards generative AI proof-of-concepts (US 10Y 4.42%), delaying large multi-year digital transformation deals.

pressure_headwinds.title: Universal US Import Tariff Threat (10% - 60%)
pressure_headwinds.reason: Proposed tariff escalations threaten to disrupt integrated global supply chains, strengthen the dollar, and reignite US imported consumer inflation.

pressure_headwinds.title: Chinese Industrial Dumping Across Emerging Markets
pressure_headwinds.reason: With Chinese domestic property demand depressed (-10.3%), Chinese factories dump excess steel coils and synthetic chemicals into Asian markets at distressed prices (-2.9% PPI).

pressure_headwinds.title: European Industrial Demand Stagnation
pressure_headwinds.reason: With German factory orders and automotive dispatches declining (Europe Mfg 46.0 PMI), Indian and Asian exporters of intermediates face delayed purchase orders.

expansion_tailwinds.title: China+1 Manufacturing Relocation to India & ASEAN
expansion_tailwinds.reason: Global multinational brands are mandating that at least 25-30% of their global component sourcing originate outside mainland China, driving India's Composite PMI to 58.6.

expansion_tailwinds.title: Muted Crude Oil & Commodity Softness
expansion_tailwinds.reason: Crude oil remaining rangebound ($73.4/bbl) prevents gross margin contraction and keeps national current account deficits in comfortable zones.

expansion_tailwinds.title: Global Central Bank Rate-Easing Liquidity Wave
expansion_tailwinds.reason: Synchronized rate cuts from the ECB, Bank of England, and US Fed lower global borrowing spreads and reduce corporate interest burdens.

expansion_tailwinds.title: AI Infrastructure & Power Equipment Supercycle
expansion_tailwinds.reason: Unprecedented energy consumption from AI compute clusters creates global shortage of transformers and high-voltage electrical equipment (US Services 54.9).
